question: Which two mantras of different syllable counts protect the navel and hips respectively?
premises: The eight-syllabled mantra is asked to protect the navel
The two-syllabled form spoken as kṛṣṇa is invoked
The two-syllabled mantra is asked to protect
inference: The eight-syllabled mantra protects the navel and the two-syllabled kṛṣṇa mantra protects as invoked.
uncertainties: The object of 'vatu may continue into the next verse; taken as the immediately following body part.
plain_english: May the eight-syllabled mantra protect my navel, and may the two-syllabled mantra 'kṛṣṇa' protect.
